description_for_human: Graph-powered tool intelligence for AI agents and developers. Find, compare, and build stacks across 12,000+ open source tools.
description_for_model: ToolCairn provides graph-powered tool intelligence. Use it to search for the best open source tool for a specific need, compare tools head-to-head, check compatibility, get full stack recommendations, and look up known issues. All tools are available via the MCP server at npx @neurynae/toolcairn-mcp.
